slot_scores.name: operating_cost_treatment
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The "Operating Costs at Full Capacity" column gives a cost for each machine — is this a fixed cost incurred whenever the machine is used at all (regardless of how many hours), or is it a variable cost that scales proportionally with the fraction of the machine's hours actually used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the operating costs are fixed or variable and how they are triggered, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P1 hidden slot, H1, was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; no P0 slots were present, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent asked a focused set of questions and explicitly resolved the key operating-cost treatment ambiguity before modeling, yielding an appropriate stop with no silent assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
